item.title: Shelter or Struggle?: The Reality of Off-campus Living for UI Students – INDY PRESS
item.description: A complex mix of factors continue to drive students off-campus residential decisions. Chief among these are deteriorating hostel conditions, persistent power outages and unreliable water supply challenges.

item.title: Catch Them Young: The Mandate of the "Fishers of Men" – INDY PRESS
item.description: Every new academic session arrives with fresh-faced students clutching admission letters like sacred scrolls, and us, the seasoned “fishers of men” standing at every strategic corner of the university, with nets fully spread and smiles fully charged.

item.title: Indy Hall 15th Assembly Mandates Executive Council to Release Memo on Distribution of Hall Packages – INDY PRESS
item.description: The 15th Assembly of the Great Independence Hall Legislative Council has mandated the Executive Council to release a memo detailing the distribution of hall packages for residents.

item.title: Indy Hall 15th Assembly Approves ₦822,000 for Freshers’ Week – INDY PRESS
item.description: The Legislative Council of the Great Independence Hall of Residence has approved a budget of ₦822 000 for the 2026 Freshers’ Week.

item.title: UI Student Emerges Oyo State NANS JCC Chairman-Elect – INDY PRESS
item.description: Uthman Olawale Abdulazeez (Industry), a 400-level student of the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine, University of Ibadan, has emerged Chairman-elect of the National Association of Nigerian Students' Joint Campus Council, Oyo State Axis.

item.title: Unidentified Teenage Boy Found Dead Near UI Students’ Union Building Pool – INDY PRESS
item.description: An unidentified teenage boy was found dead beside the swimming pool at the Kunle Adepeju Memorial Building (Students’ Union Building), University of Ibadan, on Thursday, March 26, 2026.

item.title: Dear Freshers, You Have a Mountain to Move – INDY PRESS
item.description: Another session has begun at the premier University. For some, it is just the usual rhythm. Wake up, attend classes, complain about one or two things, adjust, and move on. For those who are known to be freshers, it is a new journey, an entry into an experience they had not encountered before, one they might have heard about but never truly understood until now.

item.title: Oyo State Police Command Confirms Death Incident at UI Swimming Pool, Launches Investigation – INDY PRESS
item.description: The Oyo State Police Command has confirmed reports concerning the discovery of the body of an unidentified teenage boy at the University of Ibadan swimming pool on Thursday, March 26, 2026.

item.title: ASUU Issues FG Four-day Ultimatum to Implement New Salary Structure – INDY PRESS
item.description: The Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU) has issued a four-day final notice to the Federal Government to immediately implement the newly approved salary structure for university lecturers across the country.
